name: ai-agents-skills
description: Reusable Codex skills and lifecycle hooks: Kanban boards, Git safety, review and verification, security, deployment, monitoring, research, Telegram notifications and reviewed skill import. Skills are named <area>-<object>-<goal>; only a small always-on set is described to the model and the rest are found through agent-skill-find. Install the superpowers plugin alongside it.

interface.shortDescription: Kanban, Git safety, verification, security, deployment and more, with a small always-on skill set.
interface.longDescription: Kanban boards, Git safety, review and verification, security, deployment, monitoring, research, Telegram notifications and reviewed skill import. Skills are named <area>-<object>-<goal>; only a small always-on set is described to the model and the rest are found through agent-skill-find. Codex lifecycle hooks use the dedicated Codex events. The scheduled-run prototype is Claude-specific.
defaultPrompt: Help me manage a coding task with the ai-agents-skills workflows.
